description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) interface for managing ShareEntity objects in a Room database, including methods to add and retrieve share entities based on a file path.

classes.name: ShareDao
classes.description: Interface defining database operations for ShareEntity objects, including insertion with conflict strategy and querying by path.

methods.name: addShareEntities
methods.description: Inserts a list of ShareEntity objects into the database, replacing existing entries on conflict.

methods.name: getShareEntities
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ShareEntity objects from the database that match the specified path.
